title: Effortless Portuguese Pork Belly Tagine
description: A hearty, comforting one-pot dish featuring tender pork belly slices in a fragrant, grassy Portuguese-inspired sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, chili powder, and paprika, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pork belly slices and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the white wine vinegar, chicken broth, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the tagine pot to the preheated oven and braise the pork belly for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Skim the excess fat from the surface of the sauce and serve the pork belly slices in the flavorful sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
